input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets our preferred insurance position in full: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally, so the "where Vendor processes Customer Data" trigger is satisfied a fortiori). Section 18.2 obliges Vendor to provide certificates of insurance on request, and adds Customer-favourable extras (primary coverage, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities). Employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 is additional cover beyond our checklist and is not adverse. No redline required.
